notes: colourMatik 1.7.7 — no more wrecked colours between unrelated shots. Matching was studied on 26 real-footage pairs (AI clips into real footage, day into night, phone HLG, black leaders, sky-only shots) and the failures were caught on the actual pictures: an orange lamp turned green by a reference full of green screens, a flat sky stretched into a banded blob, green blotches from a green-screen prop, a third of a bright shot crushed to black. New: a hue-preserving 'colorist grade' candidate (tone curve + white balance + saturation in Oklab) that can never invent hues; every candidate is now judged on what it does to the picture (contrast blow-up, hue twists, blotches, clipping, smooth-region damage) after the same safety guards it would ship with; exact distribution transport is skipped when the two clips are colour worlds apart; a black/white/flat playhead frame no longer takes the whole clip down (the engine samples across the clip instead and says so); HDR (HLG/PQ) clips are tone-mapped in the engine on every machine, not only where ffmpeg has zscale.
